title: Cultural diffusion
examples: Can you give me an example of contagious diffusion?
What is the difference between expansion and relocation diffusion?
How does technology affect cultural diffusion?

explain.say: Today we are learning about cultural diffusion. This means how culture spreads from one place to another.

items: It moves to a new area

explain.say: First we look at relocation diffusion. This happens when people physically move to a new area.
Next is expansion diffusion. This is when an idea spreads outward from its point of origin.
We have two types of expansion. Contagious diffusion spreads rapidly like a wave across a populated area.

items: Populated Area 2: Gets the trait soon
draw.label: Rapid, wave-like spread

explain.say: The last type is hierarchical diffusion. This spreads from people or places that are more influential or powerful.
In everyday life, think about fashion trends. A celebrity wears a new style. This is hierarchical diffusion.

faq.q: What is the main difference between contagious and hierarchical diffusion?
faq.a: Contagious diffusion spreads randomly across many people nearby. Hierarchical diffusion spreads from important or powerful groups first.
asks: How is contagious different from hierarchical?
Does it matter if the spread is random or from leaders?

faq.q: Does relocation diffusion always mean people move far away?
faq.a: No, relocation diffusion just means people move from one place to another. The distance can be short or very long.
asks: Is moving always considered relocation diffusion?
What if I move to a nearby town?

faq.q: Can an idea spread using more than one type of diffusion?
faq.a: Yes, it often happens in stages. For example, a new technology might start in a powerful center and then spread contagiously.
asks: Is it possible to have both types at once?

faq.q: Which type of diffusion is usually the fastest?
faq.a: Contagious diffusion can be very fast because it spreads like a natural wave through dense populations.
asks: Is speed related to the type of diffusion?

faq.q: Does the power of a place affect the spread of culture?
faq.a: Yes, hierarchical diffusion suggests that powerful groups, like elites, often introduce new ideas first.
asks: Do rich places spread things more?

facts: Cultural diffusion is the spread of cultural traits from one place to another.
Relocation diffusion involves the physical movement of people carrying culture.
Contagious diffusion spreads outward in a rapid, wave-like pattern.
Hierarchical diffusion spreads from centers of power or influence.

quiz.say: A new slang word starts with teenagers in a specific neighborhood and quickly spreads to all nearby neighborhoods.
quiz.why: This shows a rapid, wave-like spread across a populated area.

wrong.0: This would require people to physically move to spread the word.
wrong.1: This suggests the word started with a powerful group, not just neighbors.
wrong.2: While correct, contagious is the specific type of expansion shown here.

quiz.say: The adoption of a new fashion style by celebrities and then by the general public best represents which process?
quiz.show: Fashion starts with elites, then spreads.
quiz.why: The spread starts from influential people or groups, like celebrities.

wrong.1: This suggests the style spread randomly, not starting at the top.
wrong.2: This implies the people who started the fashion moved to a new place.
wrong.3: This is too general; hierarchical specifies the source of the spread.

quiz.say: A group of people from Country X moves to Country Y and starts practicing their unique farming methods there.
quiz.show: People move, taking their culture with them.
quiz.why: The culture is spread because the people physically moved to a new location.

wrong.0: This suggests the methods came from a powerful, central source.
wrong.1: This is too broad; relocation specifies the mechanism of spread.
wrong.3: This would mean the farming methods spread like a wave without people moving.
